mass/kg weight/N

A metal wire is loaded up to the limit of proportionality.
Which statement is correct?

options.text: Hooke’s law is not obeyed when the load is increased from zero to this point.
When the load is increased beyond the limit of proportionality, the diameter of the wire will increase.
When the load is removed, the wire returns to its original length.
Up to the limit of proportionality, there is no change in the shape of the wire.

questions.questionText:
A child pushes a toy car along a horizontal surface and then releases it.
As the car slows down, what is the main energy transfer?

options.text: from chemical to thermal
from chemical to kinetic
from kinetic to gravitational (potential)
from kinetic to thermal

cannonball between time = 0 and time = t?
total kinetic energy of total momentum of
cannon and cannonball cannon and cannonball

changes remains the same

questions.questionText:
Smoke particles, illuminated by a bright lamp, are seen through a microscope. They move about
randomly.
What causes this motion?

options.text: attraction between the smoke particles and the molecules of the air
collisions between the smoke particles and the molecules of the air
evaporation of the faster-moving smoke particles
warming of the smoke particles by the lamp

questions.questionText: Which statement describes thermal conduction in a metal by electrons?

options.text: Atoms and electrons move freely throughout the metal.
Atoms and electrons vibrate about their fixed positions only.
Electrons move freely throughout the metal.
Electrons remain attached to atoms.

questions.questionText:
A tank contains water. Ripples are produced on the surface of the water. Refraction is observed.
What causes the ripples to refract?

options.text: The cold water in the tank is replaced by warm water.
The ripples change speed as they move from deep to shallow water.
The ripples hit the wall of the tank.
The ripples pass through a narrow gap.

barrier

options.text: Increase the amplitude of the wave.
Increase the width of the gap.
Reduce the depth of water.
Reduce the frequency of the wave.

questions.questionText:
An eclipse of the Sun happens when the Moon comes between the Earth and the Sun.
Which statement is correct?

options.text: Infrared radiation from the Sun disappears before visible light and ultraviolet radiation.
Ultraviolet radiation from the Sun disappears before visible light and infrared radiation.
Visible light from the Sun disappears before ultraviolet radiation and infrared radiation.
Infrared radiation, ultraviolet radiation and visible light from the Sun all disappear at the same moment.

relay

questions.questionText:
When a current-carrying conductor is placed in a magnetic field, it experiences a force.
Which statement about this force is correct?

options.text: It is parallel to both the magnetic field and the direction of the current.
It is parallel to the magnetic field and perpendicular to the direction of the current.
